sentences.text: This case is posted for admission and consideration of I.A.No.14049/2015 for stay.

It is directed against order dated 22 nd June, 2015 passed by Sessions Judge, Sagar in Criminal Appeal No.11/2014 affirming a fine of Rs.1,00,000/- imposed by Additional Collector and Adjudicating Authority, Sagar, under the provisions of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

entities.text: Additional Collector and Adjudicating Authority, Sagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: It may be noted here that every decision or order of the Food Safety Appellate Tribunal is appealable under Section 17(2) (6) of the Act, before the High Court.

The limitation for filing such appeal is 60 days; whereas in the instant case, the applicant has preferred a criminal revision under Section 397 of the Cr.P.C and that too, 64 days after the date of order of the Appellate Tribunal.
In aforesaid circumstances, let the matter be listed in the next week for arguments on the question of maintainability of the revision petition and limitation.
